sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant, while referring to the F.I.R. placed at page no.53 of the paper book, which has been lodged by the concerned Supply Inspector at Police Station Noida, Gautam Budhanagar Commissionerate on 30.08.2018, submits that in the instant F.I.R. allegations have been levelled against the named accused persons including the applicant to have manipulated the data base of the eligible persons and by manipulating the same, the food-grains and other items, which were meant to be distributed to the eligible persons, have been misappropriated.

entities.text: Police Station Noida, Gautam Budhanagar Commissionerate
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
While referring to the F.I.R. of the instant case i.e. namely Case Crime No.007 of 2018, registered at Police Station Cyber Crime, Lucknow against three named persons, it is vehemently submitted that on the basis of same allegations pertaining to which earlier F.I.R. was lodged, this second F.I.R. has been lodged with regard to the modus operendi adopted by the accused persons in manipulating the data base of the eligible persons and it is during the course of the investigation on the statement of one Pushpendra Pal, the name of the applicant had surfaced to the tune that he had contacted him for the purpose of manipulating the data base of his fair price shop in order to misappropriate the food-grains and other necessary items.
It is also submitted that many identically placed co-accused persons Jitendra @
Jitendra Kumar Gupta, Babita, Geeta Chaudhari and Jeet Singh have been granted anticipatory bail by Coordinate Bench as well as by this Court, vide order dated 02.03.2023, 06.04.2023 and 10.04.2023 passed in Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application U/s 438 Cr.P.C. No. 586 of 2023, 792 of 2023, 823 of 2023 and 847 of 2023, respectively.
It is also submitted that apart from the instant case and the earlier case the applicant is not involved any other criminal case.

She is lady and she undertakes that she will remain present before the investigating officer whenever her presence would be required and shall also abide by any condition imposed by this Court as well as trial court, thus protection from arrest be granted to her.
Learned A.G.A. on the other hand submits that the applicant is not cooperating with the investigating officer therefore, she is not entitled for any protection.

Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having perused the record, it is evident that earlier an F.I.R. was lodged against the applicant and other accused Leena Singh vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

The applicant before this Court is kotedar.
In the earlier F.I.R. protection from arrest was granted to the applicant as she had approached this Court by filing a writ petition.
However, pertaining to the instant F.I.R. she has also approached this Court by filing Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No.10589 of 2019, but no protection was granted to her.

sentences.text: It is claimed by her that she is cooperating in the investigation.
The contention of learned counsel for the applicant pertaining to the cooperation of the applicant is denied by learned A.G.A.
Admittedly applicant before this Court is lady and she is not having any other criminal antecedent except the earlier F.I.R. lodged in connection with the same cause of action.

In the considered opinion of this Court and keeping in view all the facts and circumstances of the case specially the fact that many accused persons of the instant case have been granted anticipatory bail and the instant F.I.R. is an offshoot of the earlier F.I.R. lodged at Police Station Noida,
Gautam Budha Nagar, protection for sometime may be granted to the applicant subject to their cooperation in the investigation.

List this case on 26.04.2023.
